reviews.use_summary: Ran COAST-SS with full in-sample LD for UKB lipid traits, then borrowed UKB LD for UKB/MVP meta-analysis and TOPMed replication. Per-variant effects/SEs, MAFs, LD and annotations are upstream inputs; missing UKB LD was treated as independence in the paper.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The reported 1.1.2 edition remains unresolved. The separately selected 0.1.1.2 candidate supplies original R exports and a batch adapter, plus native Java summary burden components. COAST/SKAT-O remain upstream R. This is a quantitative-trait method; binary/discrete calibration, author preprocessing, ancestry models and paper runtime benchmarks are not established by this implementation.
reviews.usage_context: All26 named primary paragraphs were individually reviewed in the retained intake. Paragraph36 anchors actual software use; overview, derivation, simulations, benchmarking, limitations and repeated availability statements do not imply separate executions.
